newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banco Itau to take over insurer.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banco Itau to take over insurer.

text.p: Brazil's Itausa will submit to a shareholder meeting on April 28 a proposal to transfer the control of its insurer Itau Seguros to its bank Banco Itau, the group said in a published statement.
The takeover of the insurer by Banco Itau is part of a restructuring plan to be announced this afternoon by the group.
Banco Itau president Roberto Setubal will hold a news conference at 1430 local/1730 GMT to discuss the restructuring.
Banco Itau, Brazil's second largest private bank, also published a statement calling its shareholders for a meeting on April 25 to approve the takeover of the insurance firm.
Itausa conglomerate has interests in the financial, chemical and other industrial sectors.
